summary: Iteration 6: Comprehensive testing of ticketing and client module overhaul. 18/18 backend API tests passed (100%). Fixed 2 critical frontend bugs: 1) Invalid time value error in Dashboard activity feed from Yeastar CDR timestamps, 2) SelectItem empty value error in Create Ticket dialog. All major features verified working.

issues: Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' - Recharts library warning during initial render, not affecting functionality
Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` for {DialogContent} - accessibility warning, not affecting functionality
Console warning: Duplicate extension names found: ['link', 'underline'] - TipTap warning, not affecting functionality

passed_tests: === Backend API Tests (18/18 passed) ===
GET /api/tickets/{id}/children - returns child tickets list
POST /api/tickets/{id}/children - creates child ticket linked to parent
POST /api/tickets/{id}/merge - merges source tickets into target
POST /api/tickets/{id}/merge - returns 400 without merge_ids
GET /api/tickets/{id}/time-entries - returns time entries list
POST /api/tickets/{id}/time-entries - logs time and updates total_time_minutes
GET /api/tickets/{id}/audit-log - returns audit entries
GET /api/canned-responses - returns list of canned responses
POST /api/canned-responses - creates canned response
DELETE /api/canned-responses/{id} - deletes canned response
GET /api/clients/{id}/contacts - returns client contacts
POST /api/clients/{id}/contacts - adds contact with role
DELETE /api/clients/{id}/contacts/{cid} - removes contact
GET /api/clients/{id}/detail - returns client with tickets, devices, contracts
GET /api/tickets - tickets have all required fields including tags array
Child tickets have parent_id field
GET /api/clients - clients have contacts field
PUT /api/tickets/{id} - updates ticket status
=== Frontend UI Tests (all passed) ===
Tickets list shows columns: Ticket, Title, Client, Priority, Status, Assigned, Tags, Time, Created
Child tickets show GitBranch icon in ticket list
Search and filter (status, priority) work on ticket list
Ticket detail view opens with 5 tabs: Notes, Emails, Children, Time, Audit
Timer button visible in detail header
Log Time button opens dialog with Minutes, Description, Billable fields
Email button opens dialog with To, CC, BCC, Subject, Body fields
Child button visible for creating child tickets
Merge button visible for merging tickets
Tags can be added via tag input
SLA indicator shows countdown/overdue status
Rich text editor for email signature with Bold, Italic, Underline, Heading, Lists, Alignment, Link toolbar
Save Signature button present
Canned responses section visible in sidebar
Status, Priority, Assigned, Category dropdowns in sidebar work
Create new ticket dialog includes parent ticket selector
Clients list shows contacts count per client
Client detail view shows summary cards: MRR, Tickets, Devices, Contacts, Contracts
Client Contacts tab shows contact cards with avatar, name, role badge, email, phone
Add Contact button opens dialog with name, email, phone, role fields
Client Tickets tab shows tickets for that client
Client Devices tab shows devices for that client
Client right sidebar shows client info

bugs_fixed.issue: RangeError: Invalid time value in Activity Timeline
bugs_fixed.cause: Yeastar CDR timestamp format 'DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM:SS AM/PM' not parseable by JavaScript Date
bugs_fixed.fix: Added date format parsing fallback to handle non-ISO timestamp formats

bugs_fixed.issue: SelectItem empty value error in Create Ticket dialog
bugs_fixed.cause: Parent Ticket selector had <SelectItem value="">None</SelectItem> which is invalid
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to value="none" and handle conversion in onValueChange

critical_code_review_comments: Consider converting Yeastar CDR timestamp to ISO format in backend instead of frontend parsing (cleaner solution)
DialogContent missing aria-describedby - minor accessibility issue
TipTap duplicate extension warning should be cleaned up
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed tickets and contacts created during API testing - can be cleaned up
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 features verified working: 1) Ticket system with child/parent hierarchy (GitBranch icons), merging, time tracking with timer, SLA countdown, tags, audit log. 2) Client contacts with roles (primary/billing/technical/general). 3) Rich text email signature editor (TipTap). 4) Canned responses CRUD. 5) Email dialog with To/CC/BCC. Existing test data: TKT-012, TKT-013 are child tickets, Acme Corporation has 3 contacts. Two bugs were fixed during testing (date parsing and SelectItem value).
